eod.conclusion: Indian benchmarks closed lower despite intermittent rallies, with the Nifty and Sensex shedding over 1% as early gains proved unsustainable. The session's volatility reflected competing influences from corporate earnings, global market trends, and institutional positioning ahead of the weekend.
